name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey into motorsport IT was unconventional, starting with a degree in computer engineering and a passion for optimizing complex systems. He spent two decades in corporate IT, honing his skills in network infrastructure and data management, before realizing his dream of combining his expertise with his love for racing. He saw the untapped potential of advanced data analytics in motorsport and proactively sought opportunities to transition into the field.

As IT Systems Manager for Iron Dames, Tan focuses on ensuring seamless data flow between the track, the garage, and the central analysis team. He emphasizes proactive problem-solving, anticipating potential technical glitches before they can impact performance. His calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues have made him an invaluable asset to the team. Tan is also keen on exploring innovative IT solutions to gain a competitive edge, such as implementing AI-powered predictive maintenance for racing equipment.

What sets Tan apart is his ability to translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable terms for the rest of the team. He fosters a collaborative environment where everyone understands how IT contributes to overall team success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Tan has a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small screwdriver in his pocket.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with loud, clicky keys.
Drinks green tea religiously throughout the day.
